Drag and drop to your contents folder. Always remember to backup your files!

If you also want to give him the home in the pics look here: http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1177/?


This is based of "Younger Linus without beard" by Static Opium http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/666/? all credits for the original portrait and overworld sprite go to him.
